; One conversation with the 1966 DOCTOR script, and the reply to every line.
; Every reply here was produced by Anthony Hay's CC0 recreation of the original
; ELIZA (github.com/anthay/ELIZA), which reproduces the conversation published in
; Weizenbaum's CACM paper. Lines beginning > are what was said to the doctor.

> I am sorry to bother you.
IS IT BECAUSE YOU ARE SORRY TO BOTHER I THAT YOU CAME TO ME
> Sorry.
PLEASE DON'T APOLIGIZE
> Dont you understand.
WE WERE DISCUSSING YOU - NOT ME
> I cant remember my dreams.
HOW DO YOU KNOW YOU CAN'T REMEMBER YOUR DREAM
> I wont tell you.
PERHAPS IN YOUR FANTASY WE WON'T TELL EACH OTHER
> Do you remember what I said about my mother.
DID YOU THINK I WOULD FORGET WHAT YOU SAID ABOUT YOUR MOTHER
> I remember you.
DO YOU OFTEN THINK OF I
> If I were you I would leave.
DO YOU THINK ITS LIKELY THAT YOU WAS I YOU WOULD LEAVE
> I dreamt I was flying.
REALLY, YOU WAS FLYING
> I dreamed of my sister.
HAVE YOU EVER FANTASIED OF YOUR SISTER WHILE YOU WERE AWAKE
> Dreams frighten me.
WHAT DOES THAT DREAM SUGGEST TO YOU
> How are you.
WHY DO YOU ASK
> When will I be happy.
DOES THAT QUESTION INTEREST YOU
> We are alike.
IN WHAT WAY
> The same thing happens every time.
WHAT RESEMBLANCE DO YOU SEE
> Certainly.
YOU SEEM QUITE POSITIVE
> I feel that you think I believe I wish for too much.
DO YOU REALLY THINK SO
> I am not sure.
HOW LONG HAVE YOU BEEN NOT SURE
> Perhaps my father was right.
TELL ME MORE ABOUT YOUR FAMILY
> Maybe.
YOU DON'T SEEM QUITE CERTAIN
> My name is unimportant.
I AM NOT INTERESTED IN NAMES
> Ich spreche deutsch.
I AM SORRY, I SPEAK ONLY ENGLISH
> Hello there.
HOW DO YOU DO. PLEASE STATE YOUR PROBLEM
> The computer is watching me.
DO COMPUTERS WORRY YOU
> Machines are taking over.
WHY DO YOU MENTION COMPUTERS
> Am I boring you.
DO YOU BELIEVE YOU ARE BORING I
> Are you listening.
WHY ARE YOU INTERESTED IN WHETHER I AM LISTENING OR NOT
> Your questions annoy me.
WHY ARE YOU CONCERNED OVER MY QUESTIONS ANNOY YOU
> I was happier then.
WERE YOU REALLY
> You were not here.
OH, I WAS NOT HERE
> Were you listening.
WOULD YOU LIKE TO BELIEVE I WAS LISTENING
> Me and my wife argue.
WHO ELSE IN YOUR FAMILY ARGUE
> You're not helping.
WHAT MAKES YOU THINK I AM NOT HELPING
> I'm tired of myself.
DO YOU BELIEVE IT NORMAL TO BE TIRED OF YOURSELF
> Myself and my brother.
YOUR BROTHER
> My mom and my dad.
WHAT ELSE COMES TO MIND WHEN YOU THINK OF YOUR MOTHER
> My children hate my wife.
TELL ME MORE ABOUT YOUR FAMILY
> I want a new life.
WHAT WOULD IT MEAN TO YOU IF YOU GOT A NEW LIFE
> I need my mother.
WHO ELSE IN YOUR FAMILY
> I am depressed about my children.
YOUR CHILDREN
> I am glad you asked.
HOW HAVE I HELPED YOU TO BE GLAD
> I feel better now.
TELL ME MORE ABOUT SUCH FEELINGS
> I was sick yesterday.
WHY DO YOU TELL ME YOU WERE SICK YESTERDAY NOW
> I think I am wrong.
BUT YOU ARE NOT SURE YOU ARE WRONG
> I believe you hate me.
WHY DO YOU THINK I HATE YOU
> I can't explain.
HAVE YOU TRIED
> I cannot continue.
PERHAPS YOU COULD CONTINUE NOW
> I don't know.
DON'T YOU REALLY KNOW
> I feel nothing.
DO YOU OFTEN FEEL NOTHING
> I hate you.
DO YOU WISH TO HATE ME
> You hate me.
YOU LIKE TO THINK I HATE YOU - DON'T YOU
> Yes I do.
YOU ARE SURE
> No I don't.
ARE YOU SAYING 'NO' JUST TO BE NEGATIVE
> My car is broken.
YOUR CAR IS BROKEN
> Can I ask you something.
WHETHER OR NOT YOU CAN ASK I SOMETHING DEPENDS ON YOU MORE THAN ON ME
> Can you understand me.
YOU BELIEVE I CAN UNDERSTAND YOU DON'T YOU
> What is wrong with me.
WHAT IS IT YOU REALLY WANT TO KNOW
> Because you asked.
IS THAT THE REAL REASON
> Why don't I sleep.
ARE SUCH QUESTIONS MUCH ON YOUR MIND
> Why can't you answer.
WHAT ANSWER WOULD PLEASE YOU MOST
> Why me.
WHAT DO YOU THINK
> Everyone hates me.
REALLY, EVERYONE
> Everybody lies.
SURELY NOT EVERYBODY
> Nobody cares.
CAN YOU THINK OF ANYONE IN PARTICULAR
> Noone listens.
WHO, FOR EXAMPLE
> I always lose.
CAN YOU THINK OF A SPECIFIC EXAMPLE
> You look like my mother.
YOU'RE NOT REALLY TALKING ABOUT ME - ARE YOU
> That is like a dream.
WHAT DOES THAT SIMILARITY SUGGEST TO YOU
> Alike in every way.
WHAT OTHER CONNECTIONS DO YOU SEE
> Bananas and custard.
I AM NOT SURE I UNDERSTAND YOU FULLY
> Zzzzz.
DOES THAT HAVE ANYTHING TO DO WITH THE FACT THAT YOUR FATHER WAS RIGHT
> Tell me about extraordinary predicaments.
PLEASE GO ON
> Gloucestershire.
WHAT DOES THAT SUGGEST TO YOU
> Executioners.
DO YOU FEEL STRONGLY ABOUT DISCUSSING SUCH THINGS
> Devonshire.
BUT YOUR WIFE ARGUE
> Purpose.
I AM NOT SURE I UNDERSTAND YOU FULLY
> I said what I said, but you were not listening.
YOU SAY YOU SAID WHAT YOU SAID
> But I told you already.
YOU SEEM TO NEED TO TOLD ME
> This, that, and the other.
EARLIER YOU SAID YOUR BROTHER
> One two three four five six seven.
PLEASE GO ON
> It is 1966 and I am here.
DO YOU ENJOY BEING HERE
> Do computers dream.
WHAT DO YOU THINK MACHINES HAVE TO DO WITH YOUR PROBLEM
> My mother is a computer.
DON'T YOU THINK COMPUTERS CAN HELP PEOPLE
> I am a machine.
WHAT ABOUT MACHINES WORRIES YOU
> are nobody noone everybody executioners' SCHOOL?
